title: Chapter 233: Bandits Retreat
content:
Chapter 233: Bandits Retreat

The two started fighting.

After Gong Zheng knocked away a horse bandit, he saw Goode opening and closing with thunderbolts on the battlefield, and no one could slow down his pace.

He directly held up the big shield and rushed over.

"Tie Diao Dao, let's have some fun this time!" A playful smile appeared on Good's lips.

"That's what I meant!" Gong Zheng snorted coldly, without fear, and directly transformed into a giant.

"I underestimated you!" Seeing Gong Zheng's transformation, Gude did not dare to look down upon him. He took a few steps back, took out his arrow and pointed it at Gong Zheng.

The battle scene was extremely chaotic. After a while, a large number of horse bandits fell in a pool of blood.

They were originally cavalry, but they were forced to engage in close combat with the shield soldiers. They not only had to face attacks from more than 400 archers on the high platform.

And they also have to deal with 200 Black Mountain bandit soldiers who are very good at close combat.

The battle quickly heats up!

Before setting off, Zou Yuanjie suggested that Wang Shuo bring a group of spearmen, but Wang Shuo did not currently train this type of troops, so he could only let the Black Mountain Bandits make a temporary cameo.

Therefore, each of the Black Mountain bandits was temporarily equipped with a long gun.

Combined with the shield soldiers, the effect at this time is very obvious.

As time passed, several leaders realized that something was wrong.

The combat effectiveness of the opposing army far exceeded expectations.

Many horse bandits have already decided to quit.

But the host didn't give any orders, so they could only rush towards the spears and shields on the opposite side.

At this moment, Ayub rushed out of a canyon with the Golden Fire Cavalry.

Although it was also going uphill, the horse bandits were now in disorganized formation and were bitten by the Red Flame Army on the hill.

It is about to fall into a situation of attack from two sides.

If the opponent's strong man breaks his wrist and orders to charge down the hill, he will still face the rain of arrows from the archers.

Really caught in a dilemma.

Goode has also seen the golden fire cavalry charging over.

At the same time, there were 200 soldiers of the ballista battalion on the plain.

Thirty bronze crossbow carts were arranged neatly, and each crossbow cart was loaded with bronze spears.

A smile appeared on Li Jianguo's face. His title as the boss killer was definitely not in vain!

Just when Goode was stunned for a second, Gong Zheng accelerated his attack, giving him no chance to turn around and retreat.

Even if he was injured, he would never be given a chance.

Gude was anxious, but for a while, he couldn't get rid of Gong Zheng.

"Gude, don't you want to have some fun with me?" Gong Zheng smiled playfully.

But his petrified face and smile made people want to laugh.

Ayub's cavalry quickly rushed up.

The Golden Fire Cavalry led by Ayub is a heavily armored cavalry, and also has his own "Cavalry Charge" skill, Legion Order and other effects. The impact is completely unmatched by the horse archers and rangers like the Horse Bandits.

Although there are only 200 people, there are currently only more than 400 horse bandits.

As soon as they made contact, the formation of the horse bandits was pierced by Ayub's golden fire cavalry.

There were a lot of casualties. This charge directly destroyed the morale of the horse bandits!

Gude could no longer care about Gong Zheng, and used all his strength to strike hard with Gong Zheng's head-sized fist.

The distance between the two sides widened, Gong Zheng took a step back, and Gude used the force of the rebound to retreat more than ten meters.

"withdraw."

Good shouted, jumped on his horse, and rushed down the hill.

Before leaving, he did not choose the direction in which Ayub rushed down the hill, but the direction in which Li Jianguo deployed his defenses on the other side.

He has already experienced the bronze ballista just now. Each spear only deals 500 points of damage. His own health is as high as 8,000, so he can completely withstand it.

As long as he rushes through these soldiers, he can escape safely.
